fact: On 16 September 2025 the ministry stated OpenClinic, with patient records, was already operational in several hospitals and referral centres, with interconnection to national ID and AMO to come.
title: Digitalisation de la Santé : l'ANTIM présente OpenClinic devant le Comité chargé de la digitalisation de l'administration
publisher: Ministère de la Santé et du Développement social, Mali
